target_customer: Sales and retail teams at consumer packaged goods brands, from emerging to enterprise by revenue band
problem: CPG brands receive fragmented data from retailer portals and syndicated panels and struggle to decide which accounts, SKUs and promotions to prioritize. Scout ingests the data and recommends actions.
business_model: Engagement based pricing tiered by customer revenue (under 5M, 5M to 50M, 50M and up), with consulting alongside software
product_category: AI analytics and workflows for CPG sales

founders.name: Sasha Zhang
founders.background_notes: YC page says she helped incubate SaaS startups at Menlo Labs and built supply chain data products at Wayfair.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting many retailer portals and syndicated data sources and normalizing them is laborious, while LLM driven analysis on top was widely available in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Data connectors and workflows create some lock in, but rivals such as Crisp, Alloy and Daasity offer similar portal ingestion.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Crisp announced AI agents for CPG analytics; no acquisition or copy of Scout specifically was found.

market_need_then: CPG brands pay for syndicated data and manually pull retailer portal reports, and vendors such as Crisp and Daasity market portal ingestion as a pain point; the need was established though dated 2024 sources were not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses cpgscout.ai, not scout.com or scout.ai, which are taken by other firms.

identity.logo: Diamond logo mark per its homepage
identity.voice_and_tone: Outcome focused: Grow Faster with AI That Runs Your Retail Workflows.

brand_strength.rationale: Search results for the name return many unrelated Scouts, including a separate Scout CPG sales consultancy, and no press on the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Scout is a very young company from Winter 2024 with a three person team, a solo founder with Wayfair and Menlo Labs experience, and a product aimed at CPG sales teams. No funding, customer counts or outcome events were found in public sources, so there is no story yet to attribute to success or failure factors.
notes: Funding searches returned only other companies named Scout (defense robotics, agriculture), so none_found. Competitor pages seen (Crisp, Alloy, Daasity, Bedrock) are vendor or comparison pages dated 2025 to 2026, so the as of founding list is left empty. A separate firm called Scout CPG run by Jonathan Skaare appears in results and is not this company. Homepage claims and retailer logos are marketing, not confirmed customers.
